discourse.excerpt: This college is not only for this town, but, it has to be a model and an eye opener for all who are interested in the education of women and the uplift of our culture, through the mothers of the land.
discourse.occasion: Foundation laying ceremony of the College by the Vice-President of India
discourse.theme: The colleges we need educate character as well as intelligence — and honor the mothers of the land.
discourse.title: The colleges we need

reflection: Swami's vision for colleges went far beyond classrooms: an education that cultivates intelligence while purifying impulses and emotions — and above all, the education of women, the mothers of the land. A college should be a model of how love and reverence transform a whole community. If you know a young student, share one honest encouragement about their character today — character is the real curriculum. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 9, 7 Nov 1969)
seva_nudge: Spend fifteen minutes helping a young student with their studies, or donate a book to a school library — feed the springs of learning.

video.title: The Real Victory is Internal | Short Film on Education in Human Values
